summary: MPI distributes contiguous complete row intervals and matching NNZ boundaries, with local CSR pointers rebased. The timed host loop repeats launchSpmv for iterations. Runtime average-NNZ dispatch selects scalar, warp or block kernels; their grid/row and lane/element loops cover full local rows and CSR intervals, and store each row result. Complete called scalar/warp/block stubs are additionally retained.
